F2.note: Warm roastery palette, serif greeting, clear inventory cover bars and a useful Needs attention panel make it feel purpose-built, held back by clipped tables on mobile.

H8.note: The live roast curve, plain-language summary sentence and incoming green shipments make this unmistakably a roaster's daily tool, with strong editorial typography; mobile tables need work.

Q5.note: Solid, clear desktop dashboard with a useful reorder alert banner and well-labeled inventory table, but the mobile layout collapses into unreadable squeezed columns.

defects: Sidebar ends at 900 px on the full desktop page
